text:
Maya (CS): Shorehaven day 3 — quick status check on VPC, IAM, KMS, and audit ingestion?
Alejandro (NetEng): VPC peering with customer account done. Route tables updated. Still waiting on their firewall team to confirm inbound rules.
Jenn (Sec): IAM: requested a list of required roles from them, they gave an overly-broad role. Asked for least-priv changes.
Samir (Observability): Audit logs: they configured CloudTrail but forwarding to our SIEM isn't passing the S3 lifecycle tag yet. Ingest test failed with 403.
Alejandro (NetEng): @Jenn they need the NAT gateway + egress rule for our health-check IPs (10.11.12.34/32). Asked Shorehaven to add under aws:SourceIp.
Jenn (Sec): They tried to assume-role but saw: `AccessDenied: User is not authorized to perform: sts:AssumeRole` when running smoke creds.
Alejandro (NetEng): Copy. That usually means the trust policy missing. Sending minimal trust snippet.
Alejandro (NetEng): ```json
{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-priv-agent"},"Action":"sts:AssumeRole","Condition":{"StringEquals":{"sts:ExternalId":"shorehaven-987"}}}]}
```
Jenn (Sec): Thanks. I also recommended they scope the role to S3:GetObject + S3:PutObject for audit bucket only, and CloudTrail:LookupEvents for the support account.
Samir (Observability): Infra-bot: terraform apply completed?
infra-bot: Terraform apply finished. 5 resources added, 0 changed, 0 destroyed. Plan: `apply -auto-approve` by alejandro@redwood.
Maya (CS): Good. Two operational blockers: 1) Shorehaven firewall team delayed whitelisting (blocks our health probes) and 2) their security lead hasn't accepted the trimmed IAM role — both push their cutover and increment renewal risk if unresolved >7 days.
Jenn (Sec): We should schedule a 30m enablement call with their security + infra to walk trust policy and S3 bucket policy. Suggest Thursday 10am PT.
Alejandro (NetEng): I'll join and bring the network diagram and NAT/route table diffs.
Samir (Observability): I'll bring logs flow and a reproducible 403 test case. Example command they ran: `aws s3 cp s3://shorehaven-audit/test.log ./ --profile shorehaven` — fails with 403.
Maya (CS): Action items: 
- Maya: schedule enablement (Thu 10am PT) + invite Shorehaven sec & infra
- Alejandro: prepare trust policy + network diagram (due Wed EOD)
- Jenn: prepare least-privilege role + S3 bucket policy example (due Wed EOD)
- Samir: provide 403 reproduction steps + SIEM forwarding checklist (due Wed EOD)
- Shorehaven: whitelist 10.11.12.34/32 and accept role change

Maya (CS): FYI renewal note — they're on evaluation credits that expire in 12 days and asked for a go-live once audit ingestion is verified. If we don't hit enablement by Fri, potential renewal-risk flag for AM to escalate.
Jenn (Sec): I'll draft the short email for AM to use if we need escalation.
Alejandro (NetEng): shorehaven-ops@shorehaven replied: "Adding rule now, will confirm in ~30m."
Samir (Observability): Once whitelist is in, I'll re-run ingest test and post logs.
Maya (CS): Great — please post updates here. If enablement lands Thursday we should hit go-live next Tue. :thumbsup:
Alejandro (NetEng): :thumbsup:
Jenn (Sec): 
Samir (Observability): Will do.
Maya (CS): Thanks all — I'll update the onboarding runbook with the new action items and ping AM if anything slips.
